metadata.description: Ruslan's Claude Code plugins — MCP servers, commands, and configs packaged for one-step install.

plugins.name: init-project
plugins.description: Bootstrap Claude Code in a project (a /init superset): analyze the repo and write CLAUDE.md, build a codegraph index for large source trees, and interactively enable the right plugins & MCP servers with defaults suggested from the repo's contents. Invoked as /init-project:init-project.

plugins.name: apple-events-mcp
plugins.description: Native macOS Reminders and Calendar access via FradSer's mcp-server-apple-events (EventKit) — full CRUD, recurring rules, priorities, location triggers, alarms, and batch operations.

plugins.name: telegram-mcp
plugins.description: Full Telegram access for Claude Code via the @overpod/mcp-telegram userbot server — read/send messages, manage chats, channels, groups, polls, stories, and more.
